author: libsoftiktok
text:
ANOTHER illegal alien trucker crash

Maximo Garcia-Lopez, a Guatemalan national, was arrested after he reportedly crashed his 18-wheeler while making an illegal turn,

Another car carrying a child was caught in the crash. The child was rushed to the hospital.

Garcia-Lopez had NO valid license but was still working for YMY Transport LLC, a Virginia-based company.

We shouldn't have to tolerate this
